يتكافأ (form VI)
# يَتَكَافَأُ (yatakāfaʔu) /ja.ta.kaː.fa.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# يَتَكَافَأَ (yatakāfaʔa) /ja.ta.kaː.fa.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# يَتَكَافَأْ (yatakāfaʔ) /ja.ta.kaː.faʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
